newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends weaker, arb sellers emerge.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends weaker, arb sellers emerge.

text.p: Interest to sell the spot white premium after the New York open capped early gains and LIFFE white sugar futures ended easier on Thursday. March last traded down $1.90 at $302.00 after touching an intraday high of $305.20 on light buying by trade players.

London was pressured by easier CSCE sugar prices. Brokers noted arbitrage selling of New York against London whites. Volume picked up after London took its cue from New York and began heading lower to total 2,058 lots.
